changes.comment: Docker adapter: add attach mode to drive agent sessions inside a pre-existing, externally-managed container instead of creating one. Adds the `attach` config and `grackle env add --docker --attach <container>`, a ListDockerContainers RPC + `env_list_docker_containers` MCP tool for discovery, and a web container picker. Grackle never creates, stops, or removes an attached container.
